text: Yes, there was tree-cover loss on the property in 2020. The data shows a loss area of 0.7 hectares, which is 0.02% of the total asset area. This observation is corroborated by both the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset and the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 reference, meeting the 50% agreement threshold. The lost area was primarily planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda), with no native forest affected. While there was additional loss in smaller patches (1.3 ha total), these were excluded as they did not meet the 0.5-ha minimum event size. The evidence is robust, as the data sources fully covered the area with high confidence.
